examples.en: I wrote my name in big letters on my bag with a marker.
Marker writing doesn't come off easily.
Make sure to keep the marker's cap closed.
The child scribbled on the wall with a marker.
Please lend me just one black marker.
The marker smells a bit.

explain: 글씨가 잘 지워지지 않아서 이름을 쓰거나 큰 글씨를 쓸 때 써요. 같은 종류를 '네임펜'이라고도 해요. '사인펜'은 따로 있는 다른 말이에요.
explain_en: Its writing doesn't come off easily, so it is used for writing names or large letters. The same kind of pen is also called '네임펜'. '사인펜' is a different word for a different kind of pen.

examples.en: I filled the water glass to the brim.
I broke a glass and cut my hand a little.

examples.ko: 아침 물 한 잔을 위해 머리맡에 물컵을 올려 뒀어요.
examples.en: For my morning glass of water, I put a cup by my bed.
This glass is made of glass, so you have to be careful.
Please bring two water glasses.
When I do the dishes, I wash the water glasses first.

explain: '컵'은 종이컵, 머그컵처럼 종류가 많아서 물 마시는 용도를 분명히 할 때 '물컵'이라고 해요. 비슷한 말로 '물잔'도 있어요. 물은 '따르다'와 함께 써서 '물컵에 물을 따르다'라고 해요.
explain_en: '컵' covers many kinds, such as paper cups and mugs, so '물컵' makes clear it is for drinking water. '물잔' is a similar word. It goes with '따르다', as in '물컵에 물을 따르다'.

examples.en: Please put the fruit in a plastic bag.

examples.ko: 비닐봉지 값을 따로 받은 뒤로 장바구니를 들고 오는 손님이 늘었어요.
examples.en: Since they started charging for plastic bags, more customers bring shopping bags.
The plastic bag tore and the things spilled out.

examples.ko: 일회용 비닐봉지는 돈을 내고 사야 해요.
examples.en: You have to pay for single-use plastic bags.
Could you give me one more plastic bag?
I took a shopping bag instead of a plastic bag.

explain: 줄여서 그냥 '봉지'나 '비닐'이라고도 말해요. 종이로 만든 '종이봉투'와 짝으로 생각하면 편해요. 마트에서 '봉지 필요하세요?'라고 자주 물어봐요.
explain_en: People often shorten it to just '봉지' or '비닐'. It helps to think of it as the counterpart of '종이봉투' (paper bag). At supermarkets you often hear '봉지 필요하세요?'.

examples.en: The shop's glass door says 'Please pull'.

examples.ko: 유리문을 밀고 들어가니 시원한 바람이 불었어요.
examples.en: When I pushed open the glass door, a cool breeze blew.
A bird hit the glass door and I was startled.

examples.ko: 유리문 너머로 아이들이 노는 모습이 보여요.
examples.en: I can see the children playing beyond the glass door.
Close the glass door carefully so it doesn't break.
The whole front of this shop is glass doors.

explain: '유리창'은 열어서 바깥을 보는 창이고 '유리문'은 열고 드나드는 문이에요. 가게 입구나 베란다 문을 말할 때 자주 써요. '유리문을 밀다/당기다/열다'처럼 같이 써요.
explain_en: '유리창' is a window you look out of, while '유리문' is a door you go in and out through. It's often used for shop entrances or balcony doors. It goes with verbs like '밀다' (push), '당기다' (pull), and '열다' (open).

examples.ko: 이력서에 붙일 증명사진을 찍으러 사진관에 갔어요.
examples.en: I went to a photo studio to get an ID photo for my résumé.

examples.ko: 증명사진이 마음에 안 들어서 다시 찍었어요.
examples.en: I didn't like my ID photo, so I had it taken again.
ID photos for passports have a set size.
There are two ID photos in my wallet.
Do you need just one more ID photo?

examples.ko: 사진관에서 증명사진을 찍는 데 만 원 들었어요.
examples.en: It cost ten thousand won to get an ID photo at the studio.

explain: 여권, 이력서, 신분증 같은 서류에 쓰는 얼굴 사진이에요. '증명사진을 찍다', '증명사진을 붙이다'처럼 써요. 그냥 '사진'이라고 하면 일상 사진도 되니까 서류용일 때 '증명사진'이라고 해요.
explain_en: It's a face photo for documents such as passports, résumés, and ID cards. Say '증명사진을 찍다' (take) and '증명사진을 붙이다' (attach). Plain '사진' can be any photo, so use '증명사진' when you mean one for documents.

examples.en: In the morning I toast bread in the toaster.
The finished bread popped out of the toaster.

examples.ko: 저는 매일 토스터로 빵을 구워 먹어요.
examples.en: I toast bread with a toaster every day.

examples.ko: 토스터가 고장 나서 새로 사야 해요.
examples.en: The toaster broke, so I need to buy a new one.

examples.ko: 작은 토스터라서 한 번에 두 장만 구울 수 있어요.
examples.en: It is a small toaster, so it can only toast two slices at a time.

examples.ko: 이 토스터는 빵이 잘 타지 않아요.
examples.en: Bread doesn't burn easily in this toaster.

explain: 기계는 '토스터', 구운 빵으로 만든 음식은 '토스트'로 달라요. 빵은 '토스터에 굽다'처럼 '굽다'와 함께 써요.
explain_en: The machine is a '토스터', while the food made from toasted bread is '토스트'. Bread goes with '굽다', as in '토스터에 굽다'.
